name: Wordle
description: Guess the five-letter word in six tries; a new daily word every day.

changelog.1.0.0: First release: daily and random words, on-screen keyboard, streaks.
changelog.1.0.1: Now says what it can do (permissions: shown before you install, enforced while it runs), is listed in the new categories, and handles Ctrl+C and command-line arguments cleanly.
